AppRuntimeConfig.title: AppRuntimeConfig
AppRuntimeConfig.description: Non-secret runtime backend endpoints and Google Cloud YouTube API mode managed in Firestore.

nextPublicApiUrl.description: Public API origin used by the browser (empty string uses same-origin /api).

fastapiUrl.description: Server-side FastAPI backend base URL used by Next.js /api/* proxy routes.

useFirebaseYoutubeKey.description: When true and YOUTUBE_API_KEY env var is unset, server routes use the provisioned Firebase Google Cloud project API key for YouTube Data API v3.

updatedBy.description: UID of the verified admin who last updated runtime config.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the runtime config document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the runtime config document was last updated.

SavedPlaylist.title: SavedPlaylist
SavedPlaylist.description: A resolved playlist bookmark stored per authenticated user for quick reload across sessions.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

url.description: Original public playlist URL or Spotify URI.

trackCount.description: Total resolved tracks in the playlist.

matchedCount.description: Number of Creative Commons matched tracks.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator membership marker managed out-of-band.

grantedAt.description: Timestamp when admin privilege was granted.

/appConfig/{configId}.description: Singleton runtime configuration document at /appConfig/runtime storing non-secret FASTAPI_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, and Google Cloud YouTube key mode.

/users/{userId}/playlists/{playlistId}.description: User-scoped saved playlist records owned strictly by {userId}.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Trusted server-managed admin allow-list; never client-writable.
